segments.name: Defense Software
products: Nimbus Drones Technologies and Marketing Ltd.
segments.description: Acquires and operates aerospace and defense businesses, including AI software, defense technology suppliers and unmanned systems, mainly in Israel, the U.S. and Europe.
segments.evidence: On December 30, 2025, the Company acquired a subsidiary operating in the Defense Software sector (see Note 4).

changes.text: In 2024 the Company agreed to sell its financial services subsidiary Digital RFQ Limited, which was presented as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: As a result of the execution of the Settlement Agreement and management's commitment to a plan to dispose of the subsidiary, the financial services operating activities met the criteria to be classified as held for sale under ASC 205-20 as of November 8, 2024.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company deconsolidated Digital RFQ Limited after Match was placed into administration and its shareholding was sold.
changes.evidence: As a result, the Company lost control of the subsidiary and deconsolidated the subsidiary as of July 29, 2025 in accordance with ASC 810-10-40.

changes.text: In 2025 the Company acquired Tiltan Software Engineering Ltd., creating its Defense Software reportable segment.
changes.evidence: On December 30, 2025, the Company completed the acquisition of 100 % of the issued and outstanding shares of Tiltan Software Engineering Ltd. ("Tiltan"), an Israeli provider of AI-based software solutions for defense and aerospace applications, pursuant to a Stock Purchase Agreement (the "Tiltan Purchase Agreement").
